description: This file defines the internal implementation of a generic asynchronous stream class 'StreamImpl<T>' within the Orleans framework. It manages stream subscription, message passing, cleanup, and serialization callbacks, and interacts with stream providers and runtime clients.

classes.name: StreamImpl<T>
classes.description: A sealed internal class implementing asynchronous stream interfaces for Orleans, supporting subscription, message passing, cleanup, and serialization.

methods.name: SubscribeAsync
methods.description: Subscribes an observer or batch observer to the stream.

methods.name: OnNextAsync
methods.description: Publishes an item to the stream.

methods.name: OnNextBatchAsync
methods.description: Publishes a batch of items to the stream.

methods.name: OnErrorAsync
methods.description: Signals an error occurred in the stream.

methods.name: GetAllSubscriptionHandles
methods.description: Retrieves all subscription handles for the stream.

methods.name: CompareTo
methods.description: Compares this stream with another for ordering.

methods.name: GetHashCode
methods.description: Returns a hash code for the stream.

methods.name: ToString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the stream.
